editorNote: Commissioned for the November 1 Late edition alongside the original Night Watch rabbit-and-spiders illustration. Standings checked Sunday afternoon; historical profiles and honors use dated saved sources. Social and discussion research was not refreshed.
headline: NVARC3 noses past Turducken as the juggernaut joins the chase

image.alt: The green GPU juggernaut carries its crew uphill ahead of Turducken’s brass mechanical chicken and complete crew, with two Yorkies; Chen’s two rabbits and Tufa’s three spider mascots watch from separate strongholds above.
image.caption: The NVARC3 juggernaut pulls ahead of Turducken’s mechanical chicken on the climb toward the rabbits and spider citadel.

sections.heading: A narrow pass for fourth
sections.text: NVARC3 has taken fourth place on the ARC-AGI-3 public board, edging Team Turducken by just 0.13 points. The NVIDIA-associated entry stands at 56.15 against Turducken’s 56.02. The direct Kaggle check on Sunday afternoon confirms that order: the juggernaut is ahead, but the two teams remain almost level.

sections.heading: Six points and four places
sections.text: The saved board history records NVARC3 advancing from 49.89 in eighth to 56.15 in fourth, a gain of 6.26 points. That change first appears in the collector’s 4 am Eastern observation on November 1. In the same observation, Turducken moves from fourth to fifth while retaining its 56.02 score. This was a challenger gaining ground, rather than a recorded score loss by Turducken. The observation time dates when the move was seen, not when a submission finished scoring.

sections.heading: The podium is still up the mountain
sections.text: The next place belongs to “faster machine is all you need,” third at 58.59. Above that, Tufa Labs holds second on 70.24 and Yi-Chia Chen @ Fields Model leads on 75.56. NVARC3 has passed Turducken; it has not yet passed the third-place entry or caught the leading pair. Those are the positions behind the new scene: a close overtake lower on the mountain, with the rabbits and spider citadel still well ahead.

sections.heading: Champions in a larger crew
sections.text: NVARC3’s seven-account roster includes Jean-François Puget (CPMP), Ivan Sorokin, Darragh Hanley and Gal Kaplun. Puget and Sorokin were the two credited members of NVARC’s winning 2025 ARC Prize team; that title belongs to their earlier entry, not automatically to every member of today’s larger roster. Their current ARC-AGI-3 team has now gained four public places in one recorded advance. The board shows the result; it does not identify which change to the team’s system produced it.
